record.notes: Single archive transcription; historical patch and page date unknown. Unrecorded values remain null. The archive groups NPCs, containers and creatures together; no explicit NPC role or quest-giver relationship was found. Entity kind/model requires review. Unknown models, health, combat values, respawns and precise spawns are not filled. An absent loot section does not mean no drops.

findings.observation: Raynien explicitly has a Level 45 header, Zone and Chunk Jalen's Retreat, and Difficulty 3 dots. These archive labels are not an enforced quest level or verified spawn.

Raynien has no quest-contact link or dialogue on this cached page. Testing The Finder names Raynien in objective prose but does not link that name to this creature URL. The contact identity remains a candidate rather than a canonical merge.
Loot (0) and No loot recorded indicate absent archive evidence; they do not establish an empty operative loot table.

Neither retained Finder quest page explicitly links an item detail URL. Covalisien, Adreduct, Telethym and Ceratescryer occur as text, so no component page identity or loot source can be resolved from those links.
Testing The Finder notes give /loc -18756, -56584, 14314 and relative directions. These remain separately attributed quest-note observations; Raynien's page does not independently verify them.

Keys To The Finder

Level 24 · Adventuring · Lomshir

Objectives

Go to Skrilien Point to find Skrilien witch doctors and other powerful Skrilien. Slay them and recover one each of the following shamanic devices: covalisien, adreduct, and telethym. Bring them to Adaenyl at Shadow's Edge. - Covalisien (0/1) - Adreduct (0/1) - Telethym (0/1)

Description

Adaenyl says, "In order to construct a ceratescryer, I need your help." "The witch doctors of the Skrilien have some talent at constructing magical devices. If you collect certain of their shamanic creations, we will be able to combine them into a ceratescryer." "The Skrilien are tuatiren - a religious group of lizardlike two-legs who live far to the east. I can direct you to where their witch doctors can be found in Skrilien Point." "Obtain one each of a covalisien, adreduct, and telethym."

What they say

On offering it

Adaenyl says, "In order to construct a ceratescryer, I need your help." "The witch doctors of the Skrilien have some talent at constructing magical devices. If you collect certain of their shamanic creations, we will be able to combine them into a ceratescryer." "The Skrilien are tuatiren - a religious group of lizardlike two-legs who live far to the east. I can direct you to where their witch doctors can be found in Skrilien Point." "Obtain one each of a covalisien, adreduct, and telethym." RSS Comments

Recorded by vg.curse.com.

Notes

The Witch Doctors are east of the Skrilen Point Riftstone. The mobs are 2-dots but usually wander or stay in groups of 3-4. The witch doctors in the huts had a better drop rate. (Confirmed?) Skrillien Point - Map Location: lvl 22-24 2dot nameds Warlord Thrak'ssez drops Covalisien (inside the NE hut - may not always be up). Bloodletter Sarek drops Telethym (wanders the village area the area). Strands of the Ancient - Ssre'Vessk: lvl 25 - 27 3-4dot nameds Thaumaturge Lass'Revik drops both Covalisien and Adreduct (loc -20493, -16892, 4090 SW part of the village) Jekrissk the Champion drops both 2 of the following Covalisien, Adreduct and Telethym (loc -22609, -37323, 9908 on the stone pathway to Pantheon of the Ancient)

detail_observations.label: Description
detail_observations.text: Adaenyl says, "It looks like the ceratescryer is working. I thank you for your help." "With the device, I am sensing one of my kin far to the west. His name is Raynien. He's on an island called Jalen's Retreat. He is so far away that I cannot reach him." "You must be the one to make contact, Indica. Seek him out, and hand him the ceratescryer. Once he is aware of me via the device, I should be able to speak with him in return." "Bring the ceratescryer back to me once contact has been made."
